name: Dupuytren Contracture
definition: Fibroproliferative disorder of the palmar fascia causing nodules and progressive flexion contracture, commonly affecting ring and little fingers.

investigations.radiographs: Radiographs only if joint/bony pathology is suspected.

amber: Needle fasciotomy, collagenase where available, or fasciectomy for function-limiting contracture.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Snayu/Mamsa-granthi phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Fibroproliferative disorder of the palmar fascia causing nodules and progressive flexion contracture, commonly affecting ring and little fingers.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.

sources.organization: British Society for Surgery of the Hand
